About our brand and products

AquaCulture is a Cornish seaweed fertiliser brand built around nature, circularity, and regeneration. We create premium liquid and dried plant feeds using 100% waste and cast seaweed collected from the Cornish coastline — material that would otherwise be discarded.

Our products are designed to work with nature, supporting healthy soil, resilient plants, and long-term plant care without synthetic chemicals. Every bottle reflects our commitment to British manufacturing, transparency, and environmental responsibility.

What makes us different

  • 🌊 Fully circular – made entirely from waste seaweed

  • 🇬🇧 British & Cornish made – sourced and produced in the UK

  • 🌱 100% natural – no synthetic fertilisers or fillers

  • ♻️ Low-impact production – minimal waste, regenerative mindset

  • 🌍 Purpose-led brand – supporting rewilding, soil health, and ocean conservation

We’re not just selling plant feed — we’re helping shift how people care for plants and soil.

How affiliates can earn

Affiliates earn commission on every qualifying sale made through their unique referral link or code.

  • Competitive commission rates

  • 30-day cookie tracking

  • Transparent reporting via your affiliate dashboard

  • No caps on earnings

The more you share AquaCulture, the more you earn — simple.

How to promote us

You’re free to promote AquaCulture in a way that feels authentic to you. Popular methods include:

  • Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube content

  • Blog posts and reviews

  • Email newsletters

  • Website banners or product roundups

We provide branded assets, product imagery, and guidance to make promoting easy — just keep messaging honest, natural, and aligned with our values.

Other information

  • Affiliates must follow UK advertising guidelines

  • Claims should be factual and non-misleading

  • Self-referrals are not permitted

  • We reserve the right to review or remove affiliates who do not align with our brand values

We’re especially keen to work with gardeners, plant lovers, creators, eco-focused brands, growers, and sustainability advocates who genuinely care about what they promote.
